name: fast-jev-compaction
description: Jev cleans the context by removal only, from Claude Code's auto-compact trigger (set CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE=30) up to summarizeAtPercent, refusing compactions in between. At summarizeAtPercent it cleans once more and Claude summarizes the cleaned history with fixed rules: user messages and standing instructions word for word, exact facts with replaced values, open items.

apiKey.title: TypeSafe API key
apiKey.description: TypeSafe API key. Leave unset to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: Minimum Jev probability that a tool call or tool result is still needed; below it the item is removed.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to preserve
preserveRecentMessages.description: Number of newest messages pinned from compaction.

compactAtPercent.title: Compaction percentage
compactAtPercent.description: Context percentage at which turn.complete asks for a compaction; 0 (default) leaves the trigger to Claude Code.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction ratio
minReductionRatio.description: Minimum estimated character reduction required to replace history.

maxStateTokens.title: Maximum Jev state tokens
maxStateTokens.description: Estimated token budget for the conversation state sent with every Jev request.

maxRequestTokens.title: Maximum Jev request tokens
maxRequestTokens.description: Estimated token budget for state plus questions in one Jev request.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated tool result head
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters of a tool result kept when Jev decides its full output is no longer needed; 0 keeps only the note.

handoverAbove.title: Protected turn budget
handoverAbove.description: Share of the auto-compact threshold that bounds the turn in progress protected from a pass (half of what is left under it).

summarizeAtPercent.title: Summarize at (% of window)
summarizeAtPercent.description: Context share at which Jev cleans one last time and Claude Code summarizes the cleaned history. Below it and above the auto-compact trigger, Jev only removes.

hardCapPercent.title: Hard cap (% of window)
hardCapPercent.description: Above this share a compaction is never refused (Claude Code also compacts automatically when a prompt is too long).

passGrowthTokens.title: Growth between passes (tokens)
passGrowthTokens.description: A new Jev pass only once the context has grown this much since the previous one; compactions in between are refused (one 'not compacted' notice each).
